prompt.text: A cactus lives in a very dry place, but a bean seed is being prepared to sprout. Which plan best fits both facts?

options.label: Keep the cactus from unnecessary water loss, but give the bean seed water, air and suitable warmth.
Keep both completely dry because all plants save water the same way.
Flood the cactus continuously and keep the seed without air.
Put the seed in a freezer because germination needs very low temperature.

feedback.correct: Correct. Dry-habitat adaptations reduce water loss, while germination still needs water, air and suitable warmth.
